claim_boundary: Descriptive official monitoring evidence only; no source attribution, causation, legal-compliance, personal-exposure or health-risk determination.

fields.above_who_reference: Contextual WHO 2021 24-hour comparison; null when the daily mean is invalid.
fields.as_supplied_hourly_observations: Hourly observations flagged P* by UK-AIR.
fields.daily_mean_ug_m3: Arithmetic mean of accepted hourly values in micrograms per cubic metre.
fields.date: Printed UK-AIR source calendar date used for the daily mean.
fields.excluded_status_observations: Numeric observations excluded because their status flag was not recognised.
fields.expected_hours: Twenty-four GMT hour-ending source slots per printed day.
fields.hour_ending_24_observations: Accepted 24:00 hour-ending observations retained in the printed source day.
fields.hourly_observations: Accepted R, P or P* hourly observations used in the mean.
fields.pollutant: AQ26 canonical pollutant token: NO2, PM10 or PM2.5.
fields.provisional: True when at least one P or P* value contributes to the daily mean.
fields.provisional_hourly_observations: Hourly observations flagged P by UK-AIR.
fields.ratified_hourly_observations: Hourly observations flagged R by UK-AIR.
fields.source_url: Official annual UK-AIR source file used for the station-day.
fields.valid_daily_mean: True when the accepted hourly-count rule is met.

time_basis: GMT hour ending; daily aggregation uses the printed source calendar date
